data.source: TradingView CME NQ1! continuous futures, 5-minute bars (data/NQ_5m.csv)

meta.method: Exact live-loop replay: for every session the engine sees only the last 20 days of bars (as the live bot), cold-streak filter applied from the shadow record of finished signals (no look-ahead). Evals use the MFFU Builder 50K rules ($3k target, $2k end-of-day trailing max loss locking at $50,100).

summary.how_it_learns: Each factor's average R is compared with the overall average separately in 2021-25 and in 2026. Only a pattern that holds in both periods counts as a lesson; candidate rules are tested on the full history before the bot adopts them (never changed from one period alone).
